visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a massive concert stage with large architectural pillars and multiple screens. A female performer with short dark hair and a black-and-silver skeleton-style outfit stands centrally, surrounded by dancers in dark, stylized costumes. The lighting is dark with vibrant blue highlights on the screens behind. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a man and a woman in the audience; the woman wears a black top and a choker, smiling widely and gesturing toward the camera, while the man smiles beside her. The background shows a dense, dark crowd of people holding up glowing smartphones. (3) On the stage, the female performer is now positioned inside a large, ornate red velvet structure resembling a royal carriage or high-backed chair. Dramatic red lighting dominates the scene, with smoke or fog rolling across the floor. (4) The performer transitions to a moving boat-like prop that travels through the audience area. She is wearing a bulky, feathered red headpiece and gown, while a rower in red stands behind her. The surrounding arena is filled with thousands of tiny white lights from the audience's phones. (5) A massive white skull prop is featured on stage, with the performer standing near its base under bright, high-contrast spotlighting. (6) A wide shot captures the entire arena, showing a long runway extending from the main stage. The lighting shifts to intense red and white beams. (7) The performer is seen at a piano on a misty stage, dressed in a black hooded outfit. (8) The final sequence shows a group of dancers and the main performer on a circular stage, performing a synchronized high-energy dance routine under bright, white arena lights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic pop track featuring heavy synthesized beats and a fast tempo. A male narrator's voice, energetic and clear, says, 'We met 10 years ago to this Lady Gaga song.' Beneath his voice, the roar of a massive cheering crowd is audible. (2) A transition occurs where the narrator exclaims 'What an entrance!' as the music swells with dramatic percussion and synth risers. The ambient sound of the arena is immersive and loud. (3) The audio focuses on high-pitched, powerful live female vocals singing melodic phrases with high emotional arousal. The narrator's voice overlays, commenting on the power of the voice. The crowd's reaction is constant and intense. (4) The music shifts to a rhythmic, synth-driven pop anthem. The narrator continues describing the production value while the live music remains the primary audio layer. (5) A distinct change to a piano-led sequence with softer, more emotive female vocals occurs. The narration becomes more reflective, identifying this as a favorite part. (6) The video ends with a high-energy dance beat, loud audience cheering, and a final thank-you message from the narrator over the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Emotional Hook -> Highlight Sequence -> Climax -> Resolution/Gratitude
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a deeply personal anniversary experience at a Lady Gaga concert, emphasizing the emotional connection between the couple and the music, while showcasing the high production value of the live performance.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a classic social media montage style to blend personal storytelling with professional concert footage. The high arousal in both the visual editing and the audio track creates a strong sense of excitement and celebration.
